name: Globe data card
for: A feature card for a product whose reach is global (payments, hosting, logistics, networks): the dotted globe rises from the floor of an inset panel, with arcs between cities, beside live region figures.
how: dotted-globe mounted on the inset panel with the calm area at the top, so the globe is cut by the panel's floor; a small opaque card sits in the clear top corner.
rules: Only when the product really works across countries.
Figures tick about once a second, by a few units; nothing counts up on scroll.
a11y: Region figures are a real table with a caption; the globe is aria-hidden. Under reduced motion the figures and globe hold still.
